vlans.description: List of VLANs to create (use first for single-VLAN playbooks)

interfaces.description: Interface names to assign the VLAN to (e.g. GigabitEthernet0/1, Gi0/2). Omit for VLAN creation only.

mode.description: Port mode for interface assignment: access (single VLAN) or trunk (allowed VLANs)

trunk_vlans.description: When mode=trunk: allowed VLANs (e.g. 1-100, all). Ignored for access.
